description: This file defines data structures and logic for handling configuration schemas, including schema nodes, UI hints, and path-based schema navigation.

classes.name: ConfigPathSegment
classes.description: An enum representing a segment in a configuration path, either a key for objects or an index for arrays.

classes.name: ConfigSchemaNode
classes.description: A class encapsulating a JSON schema node, providing accessors for schema properties and navigation utilities.

methods.name: decodeUiHints
methods.description: Decodes a dictionary of UI hints from raw JSON-like data.

methods.name: hintForPath
methods.description: Finds a UI hint for a specific configuration path based on hints key patterns.

methods.name: isSensitivePath
methods.description: Determines if a given configuration path is considered sensitive based on its keys.

methods.name: pathKey
methods.description: Constructs a dot-separated string key from a configuration path.
